desc:
Sneak past sleeping guards, steal their mystery boxes and outrun them home to unbox rare pets!

Run on your treadmill to get faster. The faster you are, the further you can go: from the Meadow all the way to the Sky Palace and the Vault, then up Mount Mighty in World 2.

• Over 140 pets, from a Puppy to the Secret Box Cat
• Big and Huge boxes, with Golden, Rainbow and more mutations
• Your pets earn cash every second, even while you're offline
• Fuse your pets, upgrade your treadmill and Ascend to get even faster
• World 2: lift weights to get stronger and climb 10 new zones
• Bonk other players with your bat out in the zones

🎁 Use code BOOST for 10 minutes of x2 Speed!

Like and Favorite for more updates!
